questions: Compare worker field, native session resume, extra read-only summary and deterministic capsule (source section 4).
Decide opt-in chain, entry rung, no-op identity, retry budget, phase state and handoff validation from evidence.
decision: Adopt an opt-in effective-dispatch switch controller with provider-local evidence and a deterministic, evidence-bounded handoff by default.
code_observations: The verified baseline has different chain selection in choose_route and availability.select, repeated effective tops and early last-provider exhaustion. The original ten-case fixture replay is preserved as historical baseline evidence.
Workers are fresh/ephemeral in the normal paths. Starting a new process of the prior provider cannot recover its vanished conversation without deliberately changing persistence policy.

The concise prompt omits plan_dir in failure_context and excludes prior reports by default. A permitted evidence capsule therefore needs a small explicit isolation-rule amendment, not a hidden transcript injection.

symbols.name: ## 1. Avoid the harness when the harness does not pay for itself
## 2. Keep useful shared context while it is useful

implementation_steps: Keep provider_switch.mode=legacy by default; expose an explicit effective_top mode with strict subkey validation and routing-fingerprint coverage. Version1 full config snapshots must not inherit a new global policy.

Freeze the allowed chain for a task phase from the declared policy and override rules. Resolve each candidate through tier lifting, profile/native effort and snapshot before building distinct dispatches. The selected provider is authoritative for both ladder and command.

Persist phase/provider-local evidence and an actual-dispatch receipt before recording outcomes. Keep global functional failures/max_attempts separate. No eligible provider is exhausted until it was attempted or excluded with a reason.

On semantic or unknown top failure, move to the next qualified provider. Permit at most one documented identical retry for mechanical/budget cases. Environmental, plan_defect and timeout_ceiling never cause capability switching.

Reserve enough remaining attempts for at least one dispatch of each remaining eligible provider when the configured budget can do so; otherwise emit a preflight budget warning and explicit budget_exhausted outcome. Never silently increase the user budget.

Build a deterministic capsule from pinned subtask state, changed-path summary and validation/evidence references. Sanitize before truncation, mark hypotheses unverified, append after static rules and deterministic evidence, bind it to the next dispatch only.

Keep the optional previous-worker summary field as a later measured enhancement behind its own flag. Do not add a paid summary call or native transcript retention by default. Tasks070-081 implement and review the detailed contract.
proposed_acceptance_tests: Disabled mode reproduces baseline routes and argv without changing existing assertions, except a separately justified empty-tier bug fix.
No-op embedded effort and equal strong/max models switch without burning redundant top attempts.
Both default claude-to-codex and explicit codex-to-claude max chains reach the last provider before exhaustion.
The strong three-provider fixture reaches its third provider within max_attempts=8, or rejects an impossible budget before dispatch.
Quota/destination unavailability respects cooldowns and fallback-disabled policy without semantic failure increments.
Handoff tests cover secrets, path/command/subtask validation, byte bounds, next-attempt expiry, both prompts and missing reports.
Manifest1-4, missing failure_classes, version1 config snapshots, ledger migration, design-phase state and telemetry rollups remain compatible.

alternatives.title: Fixed-count fallback with accumulated evidence
alternatives.tradeoff: No migration cost, but verified waste and reachability defects remain.

alternatives.title: Effective dispatch state plus deterministic capsule
alternatives.tradeoff: No extra model call, bounded context and a testable explanation for every transition.

alternatives.title: Nullable worker summary validated against deterministic evidence
alternatives.tradeoff: Low marginal output cost but unavailable on crashes and can anchor the receiver; evaluate later.

alternatives.title: Resume prior session or call another model solely to summarize every failure
alternatives.tradeoff: Adds retention, privacy and quota cost and still cannot guarantee factual diagnosis.

cost_model: For each task compare total cost of all attempts plus handoff preparation and review, divided by validated success. Deterministic handoff has no inference call but adds bounded receiver input. A useful target is zero avoidable duplicate top dispatches and full allowed-chain reachability, not an invented savings percentage.
unverified: Equivalent logical tiers do not prove equal quality across providers. No live model superiority, quota independence, token saving or independent maximum-model review is claimed.
runtime_experiments: No authenticated model calls; tests listed here are implementation obligations, not claimed passes.
